thread:
joel: Amber Valley reached out — they want to run a short POC next week using a customer-trained LLaMA-13B variant plus a small retrieval adapter. Can we do catalog onboarding for a custom adapter + quantized variant? Need quick answers on compatibility, perf, and any security entitlements.

maya: Thanks Joel. Quick Qs: 1) Is this adapter fused into the model weights or loaded as a sidecar? 2) Do they require KV cache warmstart from our side? Also they asked about cost delta vs our standard 13b.

samir: Adapter can be handled two ways. If it's a LoRA-style side-loaded adapter we can serve it via our adapter stack with quantized model (int8/4) but we need to run a compatibility conversion for some formats. If it's fused (rebased) then it's just a new model artifact. KV cache: we support shared KV cache for high-throughput sessions but warmstart from customer-provided checkpoints requires legal review (data ingress).

tess: From product: catalog onboarding flow covers both cases. For side-loaded adapters we require the adapter packaged as a .pt or .bin with metadata: tokenizer, merges, base-model-id. We'll run our variant-compat scan (tokenizer check, rmsnorm mismatch, layer naming). Can we get the adapter sample by EOD Monday?

elena: Security note: if they want us to ingest a customer checkpoint we need an exception for storing model artifacts (S3 encrypt-at-rest + KMS access). If they only bring adapter weights that don't include data, that's lower risk. Also they filled a standard vendor security questionnaire — I've flagged "artifact retention" and "access control" as blockers until clarified.

joel: Good — I'll ask them whether the adapter is side-loaded. On pricing: they want an estimate for running 5k token responses at 200 qps sustained for 2 hours (POC). Any ballpark?

samir: Ballpark on-hosted: quantized 13b int8 with adapter should be ~0.6x of our non-quantized 13b cost; dedicated reserved would be cheaper for sustained. For 200 qps sustained with batching and prefix caching you'd need ~4-6 dedicated A100-equivalents depending on sequence length. I'll add a quick calc: assume avg response 750 tokens -> that's ~1.5M tokens/min ~90M tokens/hr. Estimate: hosted infra cost ~$X (follow up with exact numbers in separate doc).

maya: Also flag: tokenization mismatch risk. Their tokenizer claims to be base-llama but they changed special tokens. If we detect mismatch we'll either remap tokens at runtime or require a tokenizer artifact. That affects latency slightly.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist: model-upload -> scan -> quant-compat -> privacy-review. Current status: pending artifact upload.

joel: Action items: 1) I'll request adapter sample + tokenizer artifact from Amber Valley. 2) Samir to run rough capacity calc and cost ranges by EOD. 3) Elena to surface security questionnaire gaps to customer. 4) Tess to prepare onboarding checklist for side-loaded adapter.

maya: One more: if they want on-prem/private deployment for data residency, that changes onboarding time (add ~2w). Call this out in pricing.

samir: Noted. If on-prem, need approved infra image and KMS provisioning. Also quantify memory for KV cache: ~2.5GB per concurrent session for 13b with 4k context. Sharebacks in separate thread once I finish sims.

elena: I'll draft a short note for the customer: what we can accept as artifacts, retention policy, and expected timelines.

joel: Perfect. I'll consolidate and send Amber Valley a short checklist. Thanks all :thumbsup:

[thread end]
